answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1261 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the violet. The trellis index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes a hostile operator to the back of the saffron queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier keep earning. The fee repeats 25 times over. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
